_why: The 32 dird-series -> member edges carried no source, no note and a claimTier of 3, which graded the most documentable relationship in this part of the board as inference. Each edge is now sourced to the released document itself. Every one of the 32 PDFs was downloaded and its cover page read on 22 August 2026: all 32 carry the 'Defense Intelligence Reference Document' mark, which is what makes the membership a fact rather than an inference, so each edge is Tier 1. Not done by shared-URL inference. The endpoints of 193 unsourced edges happen to share a source URL, and filling those in automatically would have made them LOOK sourced without anyone establishing that the shared document is about the relationship. That is the canvasInk failure in another form, so it was rejected. Retrieval note: https://irp.fas.org/dia/aatip-list.pdf, the DIA's 9 January 2018 title list and the most-cited single URL behind these nodes, returns HTTP 202 with an empty body and serves no document. The Wayback capture of 4 August 2026 recorded the same 202, so this is not a transient block. The DIA reading room returns 403 to this session. The Black Vault copies all return 200 and are the working retrieval path today.
